about: Synthetic vectors for the encrypted backup file that carries one profile between PEA apps. Every file here was sealed with the passphrase below and fixed, non-random salts, for tests only. No real answers, memories or secrets.

introduction.family: A synthetic partner and one synthetic child.

memories.quote: I always pick tea over coffee
we are going to Porto in spring

history.text: She grew up on a steep street where the tram bell marked the hours.
Her first job was sorting postcards in a shop by the river.

days.text: Walked up to the viewpoint before the fog lifted.
Mentioned she burnt the toast this morning.
